grade_reason: Six web searches and a check of her campaign site found no statement by Elaine Luria about AI since 1 January 2025, and none about catastrophic AI risk.
notes: All 6 searches ran; none was refused. Results covered her 2026 rematch with Jen Kiggans in Virginia's 2nd District (primary win 4 August 2026; campaign focused on cost of living, health care, tariffs). One September 2026 article mentioned AI and data centers, but the remarks were by independent candidate Matt Baker, not Luria. Her campaign site (elaineluria.com redirects to elaineforcongress.com) and its Priorities page (https://elaineforcongress.com/issues/) were opened and contain no mention of AI, data centers or technology. She was not in the House in 2025-2026, so she could not have co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act and did not sign the House letters. A newsfromthestates.com result returned 403 and could not be opened. Debate transcripts and local interviews were not checked exhaustively.
